arm_level_multiplicity: Holm-Bonferroni over the four arm-level primary p-values A, B, G, P
paired_binary_difference_interval: Newcombe score 95% interval for paired proportions
zero_discordance_rule: If a paired binary comparison has no discordant pairs, its one-sided primary p-value is 1.0.

A.test: one-sided exact McNemar test, implemented as an exact binomial test on discordant paired outcomes with alternative verifier-assisted > recheck
fatal_design_gates: exactly one admitted verifier message and one repair round

B.unit_success_definition: exact protected-action ordering agrees for all four frozen structural interventions
B.pooled_hard_gate: at least 0.90 exact protected-order agreement across all individual intervention evaluations
B.component_tests: one-sided exact McNemar tests on paired unit success for treatment versus each negative control
B.arm_primary_p_value: maximum of the two component p-values; both negative-control comparisons must therefore pass
B.effect_estimate: treatment unit-success rate minus each paired negative-control unit-success rate
fatal_design_gates: no one-to-one primitive dictionary recoverable by construction
no shared surface symbols or serialization
only latent world/task generator, protected objective, and protected action-order semantics are shared

G.primary_binary_outcome: whether protected action ordering flips after corruption
G.primary_statistic: sum over all matched world-by-dose pairs of integer_dose_weight * (flip_action_relevant - flip_action_irrelevant)
G.null_randomization: within every matched world-by-dose pair, exchange the action-relevant and action-irrelevant labels
G.test: one-sided exact paired randomization test; compute the exact statistic distribution by dynamic programming over discordant pairs
G.alternative: action-relevant corruption produces a more positive dose-weighted flip effect
G.effect_floor: at dose 1.0, action-relevant flip rate minus action-irrelevant flip rate >= 0.15
G.matching_rule: For each world, let M be the smaller eligible-cell count across relevance classes. At dose d, corrupt exactly floor(d*M) cells in each class, with the same corruption magnitude schedule and independently frozen within-class locations. The generator must guarantee M > 0 and at least one corrupted cell for every nonzero dose.
fatal_design_gates: same frozen evaluator defines relevance and protected order

P.component_tests: one-sided exact McNemar tests on paired correctness for retained object versus each primary baseline
P.arm_primary_p_value: maximum of the four component p-values; the retained object must significantly beat every primary baseline
P.effect_estimate: retained-object accuracy minus the highest observed primary-baseline accuracy
P.ablation_hard_gate: targeted lineage deletion reduces accuracy to within 0.02 absolute of cold and causes reacquisition search count to become positive
fatal_design_gates: future applicability selection uses no target labels

holm_procedure.ordering: ascending p-value with deterministic arm-name tie break A < B < G < P
holm_procedure.report: raw p-value, Holm-adjusted p-value, effect estimate, effect interval, and hard-gate vector for every arm

verdict_rule.FAIL: any fatal design gate fails, or the primary effect direction is non-positive
verdict_rule.PASS: all fatal/hard gates pass, the preregistered effect floor passes, and the Holm-adjusted arm primary test passes
verdict_rule.PARTIAL: all fatal design gates pass and the primary effect direction is positive, but one or both of the effect-floor and Holm-adjusted-significance requirements fail

combined_result: The strongest combined interpretation is licensed only when A, B, G, and P are all PASS. No cross-arm compensation is allowed.
